title: EESD multi-height (9-story) replication of the three surviving Ohtori control claims
central_question: Are the 3-story surviving claims (saturation-handling dominance; in-QP deep-yield failure with drift-depth predictor; softening-aware null) height-robust at the 9-story, or height-specific?
architecture: Controllers DESIGNED on the reduced 9-DOF Guyan-condensed lateral M/K surrogate; EVALUATED closed-loop on the FULL nonlinear OpenSees 9-story plant (modal-validated 0.06% mode-1). Actuators at floor master nodes 15/21/.../63 horizontal DOF; state = reduced floor (disp,vel).
honesty_scope: Validated BILINEAR plant (modal + drift/accel); NOT damage indices, NOT the trilinear MEX. yield_factor=8 and cost constants carried from the 3-story un-refitted; U_MAX re-scaled once by the 9/3-story weight ratio.
U_MAX_note: 5e5 N/floor, same as the 3-story; probe-calibrated so the elastic-LQR plant saturates on strong records AND still yields (controlled drift 0.7-2.7% at canonical x1, >3.5% on the deep-yield tier). 1e6-1.5e6 over-controls.
reduced_model_mode1_surrogate_note: Guyan condensation overstiffens mode-1 (~+20%); the modal-exact object is the full plant. Elastic LQR is grid-tuned on the full plant, absorbing the mismatch.

alpha_eff_measurement.method: alpha_eff=(omega_1^tangent_min/omega_1^elastic)^2 from ops.eigen on the live tangent stiffness during the uncontrolled time-history.

claim1_saturation_dominance.question: Is saturation-handling (factor B) still the dominant ANOVA variance share at 9-story?

claim2_inqp_deepyield_failure.question: Does in-QP still lose to clip at deep yield, and is UNCONTROLLED DRIFT DEPTH (not E_K) the predictor?

claim3_softening_aware_null.question: Is the softened-vs-elastic LQR margin still ~0 (null) at 9-story?
